gaps.message: journeys across several forms — End-to-end workflows are taken from recorded journeys. They are not inferred from discovery, because the order of real business steps is not visible in the page.
Token API (/): navigation to the page — Discovery reached this page by its address (a listed route, the sitemap or the start page), not by clicking, so no click path is known.
/api/orders/ord-1: navigation to the page — Discovery reached this page by its address (a listed route, the sitemap or the start page), not by clicking, so no click path is known.
/api/orders: content check — Discovery saw no stable heading or control on this page to look for, so the test checks only that it opens.
/api/orders/ord-1: content check — Discovery saw no stable heading or control on this page to look for, so the test checks only that it opens.
load, stress, spike and endurance testing — These need many concurrent virtual users over time. The browser worker measures single-user response times; it is not a load generator.
